description: Subjugate Demon Level 60 300 Mana 30 yd range 3 sec cast Requires Warlock Requires level 30 Reagents: Soul Shard Subjugates the target demon, up to level 45, forcing it to do your bidding. While subjugated, the time between the demon's attacks is increased by 40% and its casting speed is slowed by 30%. Lasts up to 5 min. If you repeatedly subjugate the same demon, it will become more difficult to control with each attempt.
name: Subjugate Demon
